levels.tip: Tap an arrow to slide it off the board.
If something is in the way, the arrow bumps back and you lose a heart.
Free the outer arrows first to open a path for the rest.
Arrows can bend. They slide out along their own path.
Stuck? A hint lights up an arrow that can leave.
Pinch to zoom and drag to look around. Hold an arrow to preview its lane.
Picture levels! Clear every arrow to reveal the picture.
